title: Ben Dollard’s singing of The Croppy Boy.
html_source:
Ben Dollard appears as a character in the Wandering Rocks and sings the song in Sirens

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: “The Croppy Boy” is an Irish ballad set in 1798 rising relating to the despair of a doomed young “croppy”. (Wikipedia) A “croppy” refers to a person with close cropped hair. (also Wikipedia)
